agentProfiles.label: Codex App Server
agentProfiles.command: docker start ai-agent-sandbox-agent-1 >/dev/null && docker exec -i -w /workspace ai-agent-sandbox-agent-1 sh -lc 'exec codex --sandbox danger-full-access app-server --listen stdio://'
agentProfiles.description: Run the primary Codex App Server adapter inside the AI agent sandbox container
